items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: No. The Nicholas father -- Nicholas brothers' father was the leader.

ctx.x: Well, they needed a band there. They needed some musicians, and the pay was good, sounded good, so we (finger snap) picked up there.
Were you the leader of the band in Philadelphia?
No. The Nicholas father -- Nicholas brothers' father was the leader.
